info.title: Multitenant API
info.description: The organization’s API for other systems. Authenticate with an API key from the Developers page: `Authorization: Bearer mtk_…`. Within v1, things are only added: see docs/API_V1.md.

link.description: A path on the product (/deals/42) or a full address on its own host

permission.description: Everyone holding this permission (one of the product’s own)

to.description: At least one of subjects, groupIds or permission

post.summary: An event, sent to each webhook subscribed to its type (docs/API_ACCESS.md)

200.description: Any 2xx within 10 seconds is taken; anything else is retried

apiKey.description: An API key (mtk_…). X-API-Key also works.

productToken.description: An external product’s service access token: client credentials at the platform’s token endpoint, audience urn:multitenant:api:v1, valid 10 minutes.

scopes.organizations.read: See the organizations that have the product turned on, and their setup status
scopes.members.read: See the people and groups in those organizations
scopes.lifecycle.report: Report the result of setting an organization up
scopes.notifications.send: Send its declared notifications to people in those organizations
scopes.audit.write: Write its declared events to those organizations’ audit logs

Error.description: Every error: a 4xx or 5xx with this body. `code` says which, where it matters.

invitationSent.description: Whether the invitation email went out; when it didn’t, `inviteLink` is the link to share another way

access.description: Why the caller sees it: everywhere, this organization, or some of its units

state.description: ACTIVE, SCHEDULED or EXPIRED, from the validity dates

seq.description: Position in the organization’s audit chain; page with ?before=

id.description: The same on every retry: deduplicate on it (also the webhook-id header)

active.description: ENABLED or TRIAL, within its dates

available.description: Whether its people can sign in to the product now: turned on, not suspended, and set up

ProductOrganization.description: An organization with an entitlement to the product (in any state)

subject.description: The `sub` the person signs in to the product with: <organization id>.<user id>

items.description: This product’s own permissions the person holds now (empty unless ACTIVE)

id.description: evt_…, the webhook-id it is sent with

payload.description: The event body exactly as it is sent to the callback
